question: What characteristics of the pedestal and piṇḍikā will be explained to the best of the twice-born?
premises: The pedestal and piṇḍikā are the topics.
The speaker declares intent to explain.

inference: The speaker will now explain the characteristics of the pedestal and piṇḍikā.
plain_english: O best of the twice-born, I shall now explain the characteristics of the pedestal and the piṇḍikā.
